calibration.boundary: Follow-up methods fixed after prior undercoverage was known; independent seed holdout uses the same narrow DGP family. Oracle shocks are observed only in simulations. Feasible intervals remain conditional on generated shocks. MA cases deliberately misspecify finite VAR dynamics. Student-t/HC3 adjustments have no exact finite-sample guarantee. No causal identification or Brazil-wide coverage certificate.

configuration.decision: Report every cell, failures, width, bias, paired differences and MC uncertainty; select no winner from these results.
configuration.empirical_target: GDP growth pp per +1 pp FDI/GDP impact; FDI last recursive ordering
configuration.limits: Pointwise only. HC3-t is a finite-sample sensitivity, not an exact test. MA misspecification/identification remain. No empirical causal certification.

empirical.boundary: Current GDP, GFCF, NFCI and REER are identification controls under the FDI-last ordering, not empirically certified confounders. Same sample within each horizon. No lag selected for its sign. Unit-impact normalization eliminates estimated SD scaling for this last-ordered shock; causal identification remains an assumption.
empirical.formula: g[t+h] = a[h] + b[h] FDI[t] + c[h] other_current_y[t] + sum(Phi[h,l] y[t-l]) + Gamma[h] z[t] + e[t+h]
empirical.target: GDP growth pp per +1 pp FDI/GDP impact; FDI last recursive ordering
